summary: The Oregon Trail entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Oregon Trail
entries.definitive_edition: Documented original/MECC text lineage; modern Gameloft version only as comparison

emulation.emulator: Platform-specific emulator or preserved text route as appropriate
emulation.notes: Record emulator/build and source provenance because the early history spans multiple versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original mainframe documentation or classic MECC hardware/emulation

primary.platform: Original text/MECC lineage via preserved or emulated route
primary.version: 1971 mainframe concept and later MECC text lineage documented
primary.why: The Oregon Trail began as a 1971 educational mainframe game and became widely known through later MECC microcomputer editions. The archive route should distinguish the historical text lineage from the modern Gameloft reimagining, which is useful but not a replacement for the original.
primary.how_to_play: Use a documented preserved text/MECC route or Apple II-era edition when legally available. Record exact version/year, platform/emulator, randomization, party names, pace/rations, deaths/events, score or arrival state, and whether the modern Gameloft version was only compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving the widely played school-computer route.
secondary.why: It is more accessible and culturally recognizable than the original mainframe artifact.

secondary.exclusive_content: Modern reimagining with updated presentation and content
secondary.what_to_play: Use only as a modern comparison route.
secondary.why: It is a distinct modern version, not the 1971/MECC historical route.

all_releases.platform: Modern Gameloft version on PC / consoles / mobile
all_releases.fidelity: Modern reimagining rather than original historical version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The 1971/mainframe, Apple II classroom, and modern Gameloft routes are different historical targets.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record exact edition/year and do not substitute the modern reimagining for the original educational game.
